text: {"label": "Applied Animal Behavior With Dogs","definition": "Applying behavior-analytic assessment and training to companion, shelter, and zoo animals, especially dogs, including functional analysis, social reinforcement, owner training, and treatment of problem behavior.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on applied work with domestic dogs and other managed animals, unlike basic conditioning research with nontraditional species, primate laboratory studies, or general experimental analysis of behavior."}
